items.t: JPMorgan Stock Slid After Reports That Senate Democrats Plan a New Investigation Into Jamie Dimon's Bank Over Its Jeffrey Epstein Relationship. Here's Why That Political Risk Could Weigh on JPM Shares.
items.sum: JPMorgan Chase and CEO Jamie Dimon have been scrutinized over their relationship with disgraced sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, who died in 2019.

items.t: JPMorgan Chase announces 6th layoff round as workforce grows by over 4,800
items.sum: The banking giant has disclosed job cuts affecting over 900 positions across three states this year, even as profits and overall employment rise.
JPMorgan Chase (NYSE: $JPM), the largest U.S. commercial bank, has increased its exposure to cryptocurrencies.

items.t: How Much Tax Does a 70-Year-Old Owe Diversifying $500,000 in JPMorgan Stock?
items.sum: Selling a lifetime JPMorgan stake looks like a simple capital gains problem until Medicare sends its own bill two years later. One retiree's cheapest-looking exit may not be the cheapest, and the tradeoffs run deeper than the IRS.

items.t: JPMorgan Names Top Engineering Stocks Amid Infrastructure Boom
items.sum: Investing.com -- JPMorgan has initiated coverage on two leading engineering and construction companies, highlighting opportunities in the ongoing U.S. infrastructure buildout. The firm identified Sterling Infrastructure and Comfort Systems as top picks in the sector, citing attractive valuations relative to future growth potential despite recent market selloffs.

items.t: ETFs Bought $117.8 Million of JPMorgan (JPM) on Wednesday
items.sum: 43 ETFs bought JPMorgan shares versus 9 that sold, for a net inflow of $117.8 million.
